identificationModule.officialTitle: An Exploratory Clinical Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of RD133 in Subjects With Relapsed or Refractory MSLN-Positive Solid Tumors

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Leukapheresis procedure will be performed to manufacture RD133 chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) modified T cells. Bridging therapy is allowed between PBMC collection and lymphodepletion. Lymphodepletion with fludarabine and cyclophosphamide was performed for three consecutive days. After 1-day rest, subjects will receive a single dose infusion of RD133 at 1.0, 3.0, or 6.0x 10\^6 CAR+ T cells/Kg. Subjects will be followed in the study for a minimum of 2 years after RD133 infusion. Long-term follow-up for lentiviral vector safety will be followed for up to 15 years after RD133 infusion.

designInfo.interventionModelDescription: The study is a single center, open label, non-controlled, exploratory study. The "3+3"dose escalation design will be implemented to evaluate the safety and tolerability of RD133 in the treatment of subjects with relapsed/refractory MSLN-positive solid tumors.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Type and incidence of dose-limiting toxicity (DLT) by dose group
primaryOutcomes.description: The number and percentage of DLT in each dose group

primaryOutcomes.measure: Type and incidence of adverse events (AEs) and serious adverse events (SAEs) by dose group
primaryOutcomes.description: Calculate type and incidence of adverse events (AE), serious adverse event (SAE), including those happened after lymphodepletion and after infusion, those related to study drug and lymphodepletion, or those that led to withdrawal from the study. They will also be aggregated by systematic organ classification (SOC), preferred term (PT), and severity.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants With Adverse Events
secondaryOutcomes.description: An adverse event is any untoward medical event that occurs in a participant administered an investigational product, and it does not necessarily indicate only events with clear causal relationship with the relevant investigational product
The proportion of subjects who have achieved best response of partial response (PR) or complete response (CR) according to the RECIST V1.1 evaluation criteria 3 months after RD133 cell infusion.
The time from the date of initial documentation of CR/PR after RD133 cell infusion to the date of progressive disease or death due to the disease studied
The time from the date of RD133 cell infusion to the first efficacy evaluation of partial response (PR) or complete response (CR)
The proportion of subjects with best efficacy assessment of complete response (CR), partial response (PR) or stable disease (SD)
The time from the date of RD133 cell infusion to the date of initial documentation of progressive disease/relapse or death from any cause
The time from the date of RD133 cell infusion to the date of death
Changes of virus vector copy number (VCN) in peripheral blood and tumor tissue (if any) after RD133 infusion

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Chimeric Antigen Receptor T (CAR-T) Positive Cell Concentration
secondaryOutcomes.description: Changes of CAR T cell concentration in peripheral blood and tumor tissue (if any) after RD133 infusion

otherOutcomes.description: Measurement of TGF-β level in peripheral blood

otherOutcomes.measure: Expression of biomarker in tumor tissue
otherOutcomes.description: The expression of CD3, CD4, CD8, CD68, CD163, MSLN, and PDL1 in tumor tissue after RD133 cell infusion
The positive rate and antibody level of human anti-RD133 antibodies after RD133 cell infusion
The positive rate and change in replication competent lentivirus (RCL)

otherOutcomes.measure: Exploratory analysis of MSLN level in peripheral blood
otherOutcomes.description: The correlation between MSLN level in peripheral blood before and after RD133 cell infusion

otherOutcomes.measure: Exploratory analysis of MSLN level in tumor tissues and efficacy
otherOutcomes.description: The correlation between the expression level of MSLN in tumor tissues and clinical efficacy

otherOutcomes.measure: T/B/NK cell ratio in peripheral blood
otherOutcomes.description: T/B/NK cell ratio in peripheral blood will be measured using flow cytometry after RD133 cell infusion
Changes in the levels of inflammatory factors in peripheral blood after RD133 cell infusion
